changes: Negotiate encrypted UDP motion over the existing pinned TLS input channel and shared UDP 47655 listener
Keep keys, buttons, wheel and locks on TLS with exact action positions and barriers
Preserve existing reliable input for missing or withdrawn peer capability and bound UDP fallback/retries
Do not capture during bootstrap; retain queued actions before normal leave; cancel stale input and retire session keys
Recover keyboard channel change while mouse remains remote; identical source engine for both directions

bootstrap_capture_and_failed_worker_clea.note: Cleanup assertion initially read a retired negotiation instead of its saved codec; fixed without weakening cleanup assertions

regressions.baseline: working integration before fixes, not the released 0.5.4

limits: No physical home Windows, Wi-Fi, keyboard, mouse, native event injection, display or battery acceptance
TLS relay delays ciphertext; it does not reproduce TCP packet loss. UDP loss deliberately drops sends on loopback
A reliable action held in transit still blocks subsequent motion to retain click/key position and ordering
No changes to OS permissions, Falcon, firewall, router, VPN, user pairing or login configuration
remaining: Joint physical acceptance in both directions after installing the same candidate
Physical keyboard Easy-Switch recovery, monitor changes, sleep, DHCP and energy measurements
